Church as a By the end of the Sub strand helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

PART 1: Appreciate prayer as a way of and after taking meals and before they leave for communicating with God home

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate prayer as a way of and after taking meals and before they leave for communicating with God home. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate prayer as a way of and after taking meals and before they leave for communicating with God home.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Church as a By the end of the Sub strand” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate prayer as a way of and after taking meals and before they leave for communicating with God home. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Church as a By the end of the Sub strand is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Church as a By the end of the Sub strand” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate prayer as a way of and after taking meals and before they leave for communicating with God home)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Church as a By the end of the Sub strand to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate prayer as a way of and after taking meals and before they leave for communicating with God home.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Church as a By the end of the Sub strand from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Church as a By the end of the Sub strand: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Church as a By the end of the Sub strand?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is prayer?
2. Why do you pray?
3. How do you say a His provision ● Learners to practice saying simple prayers before simple payer?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Church as a By the end of the Sub strand means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate prayer as a way of and after taking meals and before they leave for communicating with God home.
